parameters.name: AppId
parameters.description: The application ID. Default value: **app-1000000**. For more information, see [Multi-application](~~113600~~).

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description:
The template name.

- The name can be up to 128 bytes in length.
- UTF-8 encoded.

parameters.name: TemplateConfig
parameters.description: The template configuration data in JSON format. For more information about the data structure, see [Snapshot template configuration](~~98618~~) or [Animated image template configuration](~~98618~~).

parameters.name: TemplateType
parameters.description:
The templatetype. Valid values:
- **Snapshot**: snapshot.
- **DynamicImage**: animated image.
